channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Tamales Bring Generations Of Chicago Chef’s Family Together For Holidays
item.description: For Santa Masa Tamaleria owner Jhoana Ruiz, Christmas isn’t complete without a tamale-making party that celebrates family and cherished memories.

item.title: The Unwaste Shop Brings Sustainable Living To Beverly
item.description: Owners Todd Barancik and Randi Alexander are expanding their sustainable living shop to the South Side with a location in Beverly.

item.title: Lakeview’s Kelly Park Renovation Breaks Ground Following Years Of Delays
item.description: The project will expand play space, improve accessibility and honor the neighborhood’s Japanese-American history.

item.title: What’s Next For Steelworkers Park? Neighbors, City Officials Begin Planning Its Future
item.description: Park District officials and dozens of neighbors gathered to kick off a framework plan for the lakefront park in South Chicago. The plan will be a guide for future improvements as funding becomes available.

item.title: Chicago Journalists Swap Bylines For Basslines In New Christmas Album For Charity
item.description: The Chicago Media Chorus, a group of local journalists and editors, dropped their first Christmas album this week to raise money for StreetWise and spread holiday cheer.

item.title: El Nopal Bakery And Its Famous Cookies Find A Home Again At Chicago History Museum
item.description: The long-gone bakery, a hub in Pilsen and Little Village, is featured in the museum's “Aqui en Chicago” exhibit — and its signature hojarascas are for sale for Chicagoans to enjoy once again.

item.title: Water Main Break Causes Sinkhole On 111th Street In Mount Greenwood
item.description: Crews from the Chicago Department of Water Management are working to restore services on Monday in Mount Greenwood after a water main break.

item.title: IBPOOPN, TYPESHT, BRICKED: Here Are 2025’s Rejected Illinois License Plates
item.description: Illinois Secretary of State Alexi Giannoulias released some of the vanity plates that didn’t make the cut in 2025.

item.title: Illinois Congressional Delegation Flags Concerns Over Broadview ICE Center’s Conditions After Tour
item.description: The four members of Congress said they had worked for months to gain access to the site.

item.title: 3,000+ Cheese Grater Hats Sold After Bears Shred Packers, ‘A Christmas Miracle’ For Hat Company
item.description: Foam Party Hats started selling the grater caps after the Packers sent him a cease-and-desist for his cheese hat. Chicagoans have been ordering hundreds of them after Bears star Caleb Williams and DJ Moore wore one after defeating the Packers.
